story.title: Some questions just won't stop nagging at you...
story.body: They visit in the sleepless hours of the night, slip in with the crowd on the way home, or surface in the middle of what seemed like a calm meeting. In the middle of all that, what you need is not a verdict or an empty promise—it is a view deep enough to see the real cause and step forward with confidence.

explore.title: One chart. Twelve folds of a life.
explore.lead: Don't let unfamiliar terms hold you back. Start with the Life palace to understand your nature, then move on to Career, Wealth or Spouse. You'll see that no event in your life ever stood alone—each one is woven into and held up by the others.
explore.mobileHint: Tap the grid to open the other 8 palaces.
explore.cycles: Beyond the 12 still palaces there is the rhythm of time itself: a ten-year cycle that reshapes a decade, an annual cycle that tests each year.
explore.cta: Build a chart to see your own life

compare.title: Speed or a conversation? What will truly stay with you?
compare.lead: General horoscope sites offer speed. AI chatbots offer flexibility. Meeting a master offers a listening ear. Lá Số Việt provides an accurate, grounded destiny map that stays with you for life.
compare.tableLabel: One key advantage and practical limits of each approach

strength.lsv: Accurate destiny map, deeply personalized and permanently stored for life.
strength.web: Free lookup, returning a raw chart and automated reading instantly.
strength.ai: Flexible 24/7 Q&A in natural prose, responding instantly to any prompt.
strength.thay: Live 1-on-1 dialogue, offering immediate listening and emotional relief.

own.lsv: Exact calculation down to the minute; unravels your exact current focus.
own.web: Template text; different people with the same stars get identical readings.
own.ai: Relies entirely on user prompts; easily biased by user framing.
own.thay: Heavily depends on the individual reader's subjective mood and bias.

basis.lsv: 100% transparent logic. Every insight links back to its exact palace and star.
basis.web: Unverified generic data; drops vague predictions causing unnecessary anxiety.
basis.ai: Prone to AI hallucinations—misplacing stars while sounding confident.
basis.thay: Spoken advice lacks standardized logic, making verification difficult.

links.lsv: Interactive chart: tap a palace to see trine and opposite links instantly.
links.web: Fragmented claims; contradictory statements force you to guess.
links.ai: Isolated prompts drift away from overall 12-palace consistency.
links.thay: Spoken words fade quickly, making complex palace links hard to visualize.

return.lsv: 100% objective and consistent; standardized data eliminates all personal bias.
return.web: Unstable info; lookups yield conflicting readings across different visits.
return.ai: Lacks consistency; asking again yields conflicting and shifting responses.
return.thay: Lacks uniformity; different masters give contradictory readings for the same chart.

depth.lsv: Free base access; open deeper sections as needed with clear upfront pricing.
depth.web: Cluttered with popup ads; rigid one-size-fits-all paid articles.
depth.ai: Monthly subscriptions required; you absorb the risk of accuracy.
depth.thay: Costly session fees ($20-$100+); appointment queues limit follow-ups.

faq.title: What you might want to ask before you begin.

q1.q: I don't remember my exact birth time—can I still build a chart?
q1.a: You can still begin. Choose 'I don't remember the exact birth time'. The system will still build a basic chart and show you exactly which palaces depend on your birth time, so you can ask your family later and complete the chart without losing what you've already created.

q2.q: What can I read for free?
q2.a: You get to see the complete 12-palace chart, accurately calculated by astronomy, look up the meaning of each star by tapping a palace, and receive 2 essential insights about your destiny right away. You don't pay anything and you don't need to enter any card details.

q3.q: What is "Lá" used for in the system, and how is it priced?
q3.a: Lá is the unit you use to freely unlock deeper interpretations (such as ten-year cycle analysis, detailed yearly forecasts, or palace compatibility readings). Every Lá pack shows its matching VND price clearly, paid via automatic VietQR bank transfer in seconds. We never create a hidden exchange rate or charge silent maintenance fees.

q4.q: Where can I find my chart again later?
q4.a: Just sign in with your personal account—your chart and every interpretation you've unlocked are stored permanently under Account. You can reopen it on your phone or computer anytime you want to reflect.

q5.q: Is my birth date and time information kept private?
q5.a: Lá Số Việt treats your privacy as an absolute principle. Anonymous users' birth data is automatically deleted after 24 hours. We do not send your birth date and time, your name, or your chart's content to any third-party tool, and you always have the right to permanently delete your profile at any time.
